up: Retrieve all distinct compounds that have been tested in assays against the target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1293235 (Prelamin-A/C), where the assay organism is human. For each qualifying compound, return its ChEMBL ID, preferred name, and canonical SMILES structure.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.tid = (SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293235') AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
